name: NIH Ruth L. Kirschstein NRSA Individual Postdoctoral Fellowship (F32)
amount: NRSA stipend by years of postdoc experience + tuition and fees + institutional allowance
other_rules: US citizens, non-citizen nationals or lawful permanent residents at the time of award
PhD, MD, DO or equivalent before activation
up to 3 years of total postdoc NRSA support (T32 plus F32)
notes: Standard due dates 8 April, 8 August and 8 December (AIDS-related: 7 May, 7 September, 7 January). Payback obligation applies to the first year. Funds research at domestic or foreign institutions.
